_doc: Crime and justice (tasks 04 / 09 / 09b), read by scripts/systems/justice_state.gd (table 'justice'). Sections: general, evidence, discovery, investigation, police, burglary, robbery, assault, murder, serial, process, lawyers, trial, charges (severity, bail, weighted sentence options), sentences, prison, appeal, civil, careers. Days are game days (a game year = 28). Tune rates here, not in code.

targets._doc: Measured by tests/crime_rates_test.gd over many town-years (a town = the player household, two neighbours and 12 townies; a year = 28 days). [lo, hi] bands; the test allows `tolerance` (share) beyond each end because the runs are random.

assault._doc: Violence is RARE and escalates in steps: arguments first (SocialConflict); only a screaming argument (level min_level) between people with tension >= min_tension can turn physical, at `base` x tension x temper; then a shove, and a hit only with chance hit_base (more after earlier incidents of the pair within memory_days). Cooldown per pair after a shove / hit (days), and `release_calm_days` for the aggressor after release from custody. Never against babies, toddlers or children. An anger-management course multiplies the temper by course_mult for course_days.

domestic._doc: Domestic violence consequences (task 19.1). A hit or shove between household members, family or partners is domestic. Protective order: the offender must keep away from the victim's home for order_days (+ order_repeat_days per earlier assault conviction, capped by order_max_days), issued when they are arrested (order_bail_days, until the trial) and again on a conviction. A cohabiting offender moves out. Breaking it is a crime (order_violation). victim_leaves: chance the victim (not the player's) ends the relationship / leaves. domestic_report: chance a townie victim calls the police. Repeat offenders: bail refused, jail weight x (1 + repeat_jail per earlier conviction of the same charge), days x (1 + repeat_days).

sentencing._doc: Sentences come from the charge's guideline (charges.<id>.guideline), not from dice (task 20). The sentence SCORE (0..1) = base + aggravating factors - mitigating factors + a small judge spread. Below the charge's custody_at the sentence is non-custodial (fine, service, probation, rising with the score); at or above it jail (prison above prison_at), each interpolated between the guideline's low and high. Fines and probation are added when the guideline has them; a mandatory course from course_at; restitution = what was stolen; a protective order when the charge is order:true and there is a victim. Several charges from one incident: concurrent (the longest term counts) except charges flagged consecutive, which add on.

repeat_victim.label: a repeat offence against the same person

child_abuse._doc: Child abuse (task 20.4): its OWN rare path, never the fight loop. Each day a carer's RISK is the sum of risk factors minus protective factors (raw, 0..1.2). While raw is above min_raw a hidden SCORE builds (build_per_day x the excess); below it the score fades (decay). At warn_at the child shows fearful moods and the player's own folk get a prompt; only at act_at is there a daily chance (daily_chance x score) of an incident: an EVENT ONLY (the child is injured, frightened, a hidden case is opened). Discovery by a teacher / doctor (mandatory reporters, high chance), a relative or neighbour, or the child telling a trusted adult; then CHILD SERVICES visit and may place the child. Data below; keep every text non-graphic.
